raw.query: WITH selected(window_name, forecast_run_id, reactive_run_id) AS (VALUES ('burst1','episode:burst1_fc','episode:burst1_re'), ('burst3','a11:burst3_fc_chronos_L60','a11:burst3_reactive_L60'), ('burst4','episode:burst4_fc','episode:burst4_re'), ('burst5','episode:burst5_fc','episode:burst5_re')), paired AS (SELECT s.window_name, f.run_id AS forecast_run_id, f.achieved_p99_ms AS forecast_p99_ms, f.bound_ms AS forecast_bound_ms, f.is_violation AS forecast_is_violation, f.has_raw_backing AS forecast_has_raw_backing, r.run_id AS reactive_run_id, r.achieved_p99_ms AS reactive_p99_ms, r.bound_ms AS reactive_bound_ms, r.is_violation AS reactive_is_violation, r.has_raw_backing AS reactive_has_raw_backing, fd.is_current AS forecast_is_current, fd.superseded_by AS forecast_superseded_by, rd.is_current AS reactive_is_current, rd.superseded_by AS reactive_superseded_by FROM selected s JOIN provenance.v_infraction f ON f.run_id = s.forecast_run_id AND f.sla_metric = 'ttft' AND f.is_current = true JOIN provenance.v_dim fd ON fd.run_id = f.run_id AND fd.is_current = true AND fd.superseded_by IS NULL JOIN provenance.v_infraction r ON r.run_id = s.reactive_run_id AND r.sla_metric = 'ttft' AND r.is_current = true JOIN provenance.v_dim rd ON rd.run_id = r.run_id AND rd.is_current = true AND rd.superseded_by IS NULL) SELECT COUNT(*) AS episode_denominator, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE forecast_is_violation = false) AS forecast_passes, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reactive_is_violation = true) AS reactive_failures, MIN(forecast_p99_ms) AS forecast_min_p99_ms, MAX(forecast_p99_ms) AS forecast_max_p99_ms, MIN(reactive_p99_ms) AS reactive_min_p99_ms, MAX(reactive_p99_ms) AS reactive_max_p99_ms, BOOL_AND(forecast_has_raw_backing AND reactive_has_raw_backing AND forecast_is_current AND reactive_is_current AND forecast_superseded_by IS NULL AND reactive_superseded_by IS NULL) AS all_current_unsuperseded_raw_backed, JSONB_AGG(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('window',window_name,'forecast_run_id',forecast_run_id,'forecast_p99_ms',forecast_p99_ms,'forecast_is_violation',forecast_is_violation,'reactive_run_id',reactive_run_id,'reactive_p99_ms',reactive_p99_ms,'reactive_is_violation',reactive_is_violation) ORDER BY window_name) AS per_window FROM paired
